data.long_meaning: From the French word 'franche' meaning 'free' or 'frank'. The name Franchette is a diminutive of Francine, which is derived from the French word 'franc' meaning 'free'. It was often given to French children born free, as opposed to those born into servitude. The name Franchette carries the meaning “Free, Frank” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Franchette usually hope their child will grow to embody free, frank and live with faith, good character and purpose.
